title: Stratos 4 (2004)
justification: The OVA's episodes 1 "Return to Base" (2004-05-28) and 2 "Dispersion" (2004-08-01) are TVDB season 0 episodes 2 "Code X-1 : Return To Base" (2004-05-28) and 3 "Code X-2 : Dispersion" (2004-08-27), one later than the default placed them. AniDB special S1 "Stratos 4.1: Dutch Roll" (2004-05-28) is season 0 episode 1 "Code XXX: Dutch Roll" (2004-05-28), not episode 6 "Code 208 : Piper on the Target" (Advance Kanketsuhen episode 2). S2 "Shimojishima Holiday", S3 and S4 "Mania no Yoru", S5 "Hikouki Suki Staff Extra" and S6 "Okabe Isaku's Aeroplane Lecture" have no TVDB episode and are unmapped. TMDB 34182 season 0 lists the same six episodes in the same order, so TMDB takes the same offset and row.
